title: 第9章 你们的人什么时候动手第10章 天牢暴动
slug: 镇守魔教圣女我一天涨一年功力
lines: 天牢丁字号的日子，枯燥得像是一潭死水。
除了偶尔传来的惨叫声，就只剩下老鼠啃噬木头的沙沙声。
陈然提着饭桶，走在阴暗潮湿的甬道里。
他的脚步很轻，每一步都踩在石板的同一位置，仿佛经过了精密的计算。
今天是个好日子。
因为又有经验包要刷了。
丁字号十三号房。
这里关着一个进来好多年的犯人。
是个瘦小的中年人，尖嘴猴腮，一双眼睛滴溜溜乱转，哪怕是戴着沉重的枷锁，也掩盖不住那股子贼眉鼠眼的气质。
李飞。
绰号“飞天鼠”。
江湖上赫赫有名的大盗，轻功卓绝，号称“皇宫大内也去得”。
结果这厮真去了。
不仅去了，还偷了三皇子最喜爱的一尊玉马。
然后就被六扇门的高手追杀了两千里，最后被打断了双腿，废了七品修为，像条死狗一样扔进了天牢。
陈然走到牢房前，放下饭桶。
“吃饭。”
他敲了敲栅栏。
李飞缩在墙角，听到声音，艰难地爬了过来。
看到桶里的饭菜，他的眼睛瞬间亮了。
红烧肉，白米饭，还有一壶酒。
这配置，在天牢里简直就是五星级待遇。
但李飞的脸色却瞬间变得惨白。
“断……断头饭？”
他的声音在颤抖，筷子都拿不稳。
陈然没有说话，只是静静地看着他。
默认了。
李飞手里的筷子掉在地上。
他瘫坐在地上，眼中的光芒迅速黯淡下去。
“没想到……我李飞纵横江湖二十年，最后竟然死在这个鬼地方。”
他惨笑一声，抓起酒壶，猛灌了一口。
“咳咳咳……”
辛辣的酒水呛得他眼泪直流。
“小狱卒。”
李飞抹了一把脸，抬头看向陈然。
那双原本充满恐惧的眼睛里，此刻却多了一丝莫名的嘲讽。
“看你年纪轻轻，怎么就想不开来这种地方当差？”
“这天牢煞气重得很，就算是武者，待久了也会折寿。”
他指了指陈然的眉心。
“我看你印堂发黑，怕是也活不长咯。”
content_en:
The days in Tianlao Tinghao were as boring as a pool of stagnant water.
Apart from the occasional screams, there was only the rustling sound of rats gnawing at the wood.
Chen Ran carried the rice bucket and walked in the dark and damp corridor.
His steps were very light, and each step landed on the same spot on the stone slab, as if he had made precise calculations.
Today is a good day.
Because there are experience packs to grind again.
T-shaped room thirteen.
There is a prisoner who has been here for many years.
He is a thin middle-aged man with a pointed mouth and monkey cheeks, and a pair of eyes that wander around. Even if he is wearing heavy shackles, he cannot hide his sinister look.
Li Fei.
Nicknamed "Flying Rat".
A well-known thief in the world of martial arts, with outstanding dexterity skills, he is known as "he can even go to the palace".
As a result, this guy really went away.
Not only did he go, but he also stole the third prince's favorite jade horse.
Then he was chased for two thousand miles by masters from the Six Gates, and finally his legs were broken, his seventh-level cultivation was abolished, and he was thrown into the sky prison like a dead dog.
Chen Ran walked to the cell and put down the food bucket.
"Eat."
He knocked on the fence.
Li Fei huddled in the corner, heard the sound, and crawled over with difficulty.
When he saw the food in the bucket, his eyes instantly lit up.
Braised pork, white rice, and a pot of wine.
This configuration is simply five-star treatment in Tianlao.
But Li Fei's face instantly turned pale.
"Death... deprivation?"
His voice was trembling, and he couldn't hold his chopsticks steady.
Chen Ran didn't speak, just looked at him quietly.
Default.
The chopsticks in Li Fei's hand fell to the ground.
He collapsed on the ground, the light in his eyes quickly dimming.
"I didn't expect... I, Li Fei, have been in the world for twenty years and finally died in this damn place."
He laughed miserably, grabbed the wine bottle, and took a swig.
"Cough cough cough..."
The spicy drink made him cry.
"Little jailor."
Li Fei wiped his face and looked up at Chen Ran.
The eyes that were originally full of fear now had a trace of inexplicable ridicule.
"Looking at your young age, why can't you think of working in a place like this?"
"The evil spirit of Tianlao is very strong today. Even a warrior will lose his life if he stays here for a long time."
He pointed at Chen Ran's eyebrows.
"I see your hall is darkened, I'm afraid you won't live long."
title_en: Chapter 9: When will your people take action? Chapter 10: Heavenly Prison Riot
